sql: SELECT 'F' k, f.market_ticker t, f.side||'/'||f.action||' '||f.price||'c x'||f.quantity||' fee '||f.fee||' @'||(f.raw_fill_json->>'created_time') d FROM fills f JOIN live_orders o ON o.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id WHERE o.strategy='Alimm1' AND f.market_ticker LIKE 'KXMAMDANIMENTION-26NOV18%' AND f.filled_at > now()-interval '1 hour' UNION ALL SELECT 'O', market_ticker, status||' '||coalesce(cancel_reason,'-')||' '||side||'/'||action||' '||limit_price||'c x'||quantity||' '||to_char(created_at,'MM-DD HH24:MI') FROM live_orders WHERE strategy='Alimm1' AND created_at > now()-interval '1 hour' UNION ALL SELECT 'P', market_ticker, to_char(captured_at,'HH24:MI')||' '||quantity_fp::text FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (market_ticker) market_ticker, captured_at, quantity_fp FROM positions WHERE market_ticker LIKE 'KXMAMDANIMENTION-26NOV18%' AND captured_at > now()-interval '30 minutes' ORDER BY market_ticker, captured_at DESC) p ORDER BY 1,2
